-- SQL: Gift card merge anomaly detection
-- Multiple cards merged into single card in short timeframe
SELECT
    destination_card,
    COUNT(DISTINCT source_card) AS source_card_count,
    SUM(transfer_amount) AS total_transferred,
    MIN(transfer_time) AS first_transfer,
    MAX(transfer_time) AS last_transfer,
    DATEDIFF(minute, MIN(transfer_time), MAX(transfer_time)) AS window_minutes
FROM gift_card_transfers
WHERE transfer_time >= DATEADD(day, -7, GETDATE())
GROUP BY destination_card
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT source_card) >= 3
   AND DATEDIFF(minute, MIN(transfer_time), MAX(transfer_time)) < 60
ORDER BY source_card_count DESC
rules.title: TP-0068 detection rule (sql)
